12 For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart. (Hebrews 4:12 KJV)

The word “quick” in this verse means “to live”, therefore it is saying that the Word of God is alive, and powerful. The “dividing asunder of soul and spirit” is saying that the Word is sharp enough to divide the heart (soul and spirit together comprise the heart of the believer). Soul and spirit are like the joints and marrow of the body, in that they are joined together as one unit. The Word of God is the only thing that can divide the soul and spirit, and because it is alive, it can cut through the hardest of hearts that man have. Preaching the Word of God, and the faith that it produces, to those that accept it, can cut through all the unbelief that the devil and this world has put into the hearts of man.

The living Word of God can give us great insight into the thoughts and intents of the heart of man, and by studying the Word, one can get perception that will enable you to look upon the heart of man, and discern the intent of the heart. God’s Word is the only way to get the spiritual understanding that a Christian needs to be able to walk in the spirit, and to get the understanding that it takes to be able to live the Christian life. How a born again Christian can expect to serve God effectively without utilizing the Gifts of the Holy Ghost (1 Corinthians 12:8-10), and studying the Word (Romans 12:2), is something I don’t understand. That is the only way that you can get to truly know God, and that is what salvation is all about - relationship with the Father and Jesus Christ (John 17:3). Get in the Word daily and Glorify God by letting your light shine in this dark and corrupt world. Go out and do the works that Jesus did, and commanded us to do (John 14:12), and create a revival yourself. Let’s do it!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
